name: The Noor Project
mission: The Noor Project works towards overcoming poverty, illness, and illiteracy with both short and long-term approaches. Our mission is rooted in self-sufficiency, empowering poverty-stricken communities with tools and resources including education, mindset training, and employment.
theoryOfChange: We aim at the root causes of poverty among families in Pakistan to stop the cycle from repeating. We enroll families into programs that meet their needs. Once their member graduates from our vocational course and secures employment, the family is taken off the list for the ration packets and the empty spot is given to another family in need.

rich_narrative.summary: The Noor Project provides direct aid, medical care, and vocational training in Pakistan to support families living below the poverty line. In its 2023 Form 990 filing, the organization reported a <cite id="3">total revenue of $1,759,964</cite> and demonstrated significant momentum with a <cite id="3">three-year revenue CAGR of 29.6%</cite>. The charity delivers direct services including a grammar school, a health clinic, a food bank, and job training centers. However, donors should note that no financial filings newer than FY2023 are available — donors should treat this 3-year-old financial picture with caution. Furthermore, while tax filings show a program expense ratio of 80.0%, the score calculation reflects a cash-adjusted <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 80.0%</cite>. The organization maintains an exceptionally low unit cost of approximately <cite id="1">$2.09 per beneficiary</cite> across its direct service programs.
